हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Billionaire who owns the aircraft boards his own plane in a mechanic's uniform to identify why customers are not complaining so much about the airline. He gets treated badly, until the staff finds out who he is.
